title: Migrate decision support export records from TypedDict to dataclasses
description:
Replace the decision support leaf records in `schemas/game_export_types.py` with dataclasses: `Choice`, `MultiAmountItem`, and `PilotContext`.

Keep this PR limited to those supporting records and the direct construction/consumption sites. Do not migrate `Decision` itself in the same PR; that should remain a separate review because it will touch more code.

The purpose of this slice is to land the nested decision support objects first so the later `Decision` migration has fewer moving parts.
